name: Chat & general assistants
short: Everyday thinking, explaining, and drafting partners
description: General-purpose assistants for thinking out loud, explaining a subject, searching the web, and drafting a first pass. This group also includes local and open-source options for people who want more control over where their conversations live.
tip: Start with one assistant instead of installing ten. Give it a specific job, check important claims against a primary source, and never paste passwords, patient details, unpublished manuscripts, or other confidential material into a free account.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.signup: Email, Google, Apple, or Microsoft sign-in. No card is expected for the free web plan; phone verification may appear.
tools.free: Web, desktop, iOS, and Android chat on the free plan, including file and photo analysis, voice conversation, web search, and limited image creation.
tools.limits: Message and tool-use caps vary by model and demand. Newest reasoning or agentic features, higher usage, and some tools are paid. Model access can change.
tools.best_for: A first all-rounder for explaining a topic, brainstorming, drafting, and learning by conversation.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.signup: Free Microsoft account. No card for the basic web app; some Microsoft 365 integrations need a paid plan.
tools.free: Free conversational AI with web grounding, image understanding, voice chat, and image generation through a Microsoft account.
tools.limits: Image creation relies on a limited boost allowance; premium reasoning, some Office integrations, and larger usage quotas require paid plans.
tools.best_for: Everyday research and drafting, especially if you already use Windows, Edge, or Microsoft 365.

tools.name: Google Gemini
tools.signup: Free Google account. No card for the web app; age, region, and feature-availability rules apply.
tools.free: Free access to Gemini models, chat, web grounding, photo and file uploads, voice, and some image and research features with a Google account.
tools.limits: Daily and per-feature caps apply. Deep Research, video/image generation, the most capable models, and very large uploads have stricter limits or paid access.
tools.best_for: A mainstream assistant with strong Google-ecosystem integration and multimodal questions.

tools.name: Claude
tools.signup: Email or Google sign-in. No card for the free plan; phone verification may be requested.
tools.free: Web, desktop, and mobile chat with file uploads, long-document reading, writing help, and limited AI-powered artifacts/tools.
tools.limits: A daily usage allowance resets periodically. Hit the cap and you must wait or upgrade. Some advanced models, longer usage, and higher file/tool limits are paid.
tools.best_for: Careful writing, document questions, editing, and thoughtful explanations in a calm interface.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.signup: Email, Google, or Apple sign-in. No card expected for the Free plan; advanced-search limits apply.
tools.free: AI answers with cited web sources, follow-up questions, file analysis, and a limited number of advanced research searches.
tools.limits: Advanced model/search allowances are capped and reset over time. File uploads, deeper research, image creation, and higher usage are limited or paid.
tools.best_for: Quick source-backed questions when you want clickable citations rather than a plain chat answer.

tools.name: Mistral Le Chat
tools.signup: Email or Google sign-in. No card expected for the Free plan; availability varies by country.
tools.free: Free chat with Mistral models, web search, document analysis, image understanding, and some image generation in supported regions.
tools.limits: Daily usage caps and slower responses at busy times. Some reasoning, agent, image, and enterprise features are paid or region-dependent.
tools.best_for: A clean, fast assistant from a European AI provider, with optional paid upgrades.

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.signup: Email or phone sign-up. No card expected for web chat; verify regional availability and the privacy terms.
tools.free: Free web and mobile chat access to DeepSeek reasoning and general models, including file reading and web search in supported versions.
tools.limits: Usage is capacity-limited and can slow or pause during peak demand. File sizes and advanced tools are capped. Review the privacy policy before entering sensitive text.
tools.best_for: Free access to a capable reasoning-style assistant for math, logic, and coding conversations.

tools.name: Qwen Chat
tools.signup: Qwen/Alibaba account sign-in. No card expected for free chat; regional availability varies.
tools.free: Free web chat with Alibaba's Qwen models, file and image inputs, search, and some generation tools.
tools.limits: Free quotas, model availability, and tool access vary by region and demand. High-volume or premium capabilities can be restricted.
tools.best_for: Testing capable open-model style assistance, especially for multilingual and document tasks.

tools.name: Kimi
tools.signup: Email or phone sign-up. No card expected for free chat; verify regional availability.
tools.free: Free assistant from Moonshot AI with long-document reading, web search, file analysis, and everyday writing help.
tools.limits: Daily usage and file limits apply, and some tools, models, or regions may differ. Paid plans add capacity; check data-handling terms before uploading private files.
tools.best_for: Reading long reports or books and asking questions across a large amount of text.

tools.name: Meta AI
tools.signup: Meta account or sign-in through Facebook, Instagram, or WhatsApp. No card for basic chat; country rules apply.
tools.free: Free chat through the web and Meta apps, with web answers, image generation, and image-editing features in supported countries.
tools.limits: Availability varies by country and account. Image generations and some tools have usage caps; advanced features are tied to Meta accounts.
tools.best_for: Fast, casual questions and image ideas if you already use Facebook, Instagram, or WhatsApp.

tools.name: Grok
tools.signup: X account or a supported sign-in. No card expected for limited free chat; quotas and regions vary.
tools.free: Limited free use of Grok through its web and apps, including real-time web answers and image generation.
tools.limits: Free query and generation quotas are low and can change. Heavy use, advanced models, and some image/video features need a paid plan.
tools.best_for: Checking current events and trying a more informal assistant with real-time web access.

tools.name: Poe
tools.signup: Email, Google, or Apple sign-in. No card for the Free plan; premium bots consume points quickly.
tools.free: One account for many chat models and community-built bots, with a daily allocation of compute points.
tools.limits: Most models consume points per message; premium bots cost more. The free allowance is small, and higher limits or newer models require a subscription.
tools.best_for: Comparing several assistants side by side before choosing one to use regularly.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
tools.signup: No account required for basic access. No card; daily limits apply and AI chat is not available everywhere.
tools.free: Anonymous-style AI chat inside DuckDuckGo, with a small menu of well-known models and no need to build a chatbot profile.
tools.limits: Daily usage limits apply, model choices are limited, and chats are not a full document workspace. AI features may be unavailable in some regions.
tools.best_for: A lower-friction way to ask general questions without creating another AI account.

tools.name: Brave Leo
tools.signup: Install Brave; no separate AI account or card for the base assistant. Premium models are optional.
tools.free: AI assistant built into the Brave desktop and mobile browsers, with page summaries, web answers, and chat.
tools.limits: The free tier uses a limited model allowance; advanced models, longer chats, and some features require Brave Leo Premium.
tools.best_for: Summarizing or questioning the page you are already viewing without switching apps.

tools.name: Character.AI
tools.signup: Email or Google/Apple sign-in. No card for free chat; age rules, queues, and ads apply.
tools.free: Free conversations with user-created characters and assistants for role-play, brainstorming, language practice, and entertainment.
tools.limits: Free chats can involve queues, ads, message/context limits, and lower priority. Character quality varies widely. Do not share personal or medical details.
tools.best_for: Fiction brainstorming, role-play, and playful conversation practice, not factual research.

tools.name: Jan
tools.signup: Desktop install with no vendor account or card. You choose and download models separately.
tools.free: An open-source desktop chat app that runs local models offline after download, can connect to remote APIs, and keeps a familiar chat interface.
tools.limits: Local response quality depends on your computer and model size. You pay for hardware and electricity, not a chat subscription. Setup is more technical than a website.
tools.best_for: Private, offline experimentation with local AI on a capable laptop or desktop.

tools.name: LM Studio
tools.signup: Desktop install; no vendor account or card. Accept the app terms, then download models yourself.
tools.free: A free desktop app for downloading and chatting with local language models through a polished graphical interface.
tools.limits: No cloud chat allowance; performance and available model sizes depend on RAM, VRAM, and your CPU. Large models may not fit. Review its current license for commercial use.
tools.best_for: A gentler entry into local models if you prefer buttons to command-line tools.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.signup: Install locally with no vendor account or card. Commands and local models require terminal comfort.
tools.free: Open-source runtime for downloading and running local language models with one command, plus an API local apps can use.
tools.limits: You supply the hardware and disk space. Model quality varies, and command-line comfort helps. Large models can be slow or impossible on modest machines.
tools.best_for: Building a private local AI setup you can reuse in other apps and scripts.

tools.name: Open WebUI
tools.signup: Self-hosted install with a local admin account; no vendor card. You supply the model backend and server.
tools.free: An open-source, self-hosted web interface for local or remote model backends, with chat folders, retrieval, and multi-user features.
tools.limits: You run and maintain the server, storage, and models. Some features need extra configuration or an external model/API. It is not a hosted assistant by itself.
tools.best_for: A family or small team that wants one private chat interface over local models.

tools.name: LibreChat
tools.signup: Self-hosted install with a local account; no vendor card. You supply model access and server maintenance.
tools.free: Open-source chat interface you can self-host, with support for multiple providers, conversations, files, and agent-style tools depending on configuration.
tools.limits: You bring model access and run the server. Remote models cost API money; local models cost hardware. Setup and updates are your responsibility.
tools.best_for: Tinkerers who want one private interface with several model providers and more control than a consumer app.

tools.name: GPT4All
tools.signup: Desktop install with no cloud account or card. The app and model downloads are separate steps.
tools.free: Free, open-source desktop chat with local models, document chat, and no cloud account required.
tools.limits: Runs within your machine's memory, so larger models may be slow. Model selection, hardware support, and feature quality vary. You are responsible for model licenses.
tools.best_for: Offline, private desktop chat on Windows, macOS, or Linux without a cloud subscription.

tools.name: Google AI Studio
tools.signup: Free Google account. No card for the browser workbench; API use follows project quotas and billing rules.
tools.free: A free browser workbench for prompting Gemini models, comparing settings, saving prompts, and generating starter code for apps.
tools.limits: Free API and app usage is rate-limited by model and project. Higher limits require billing. Prompts and files may be handled under Google's terms; do not use it for private patient data.
tools.best_for: Learning how model settings work and prototyping an AI feature without installing anything.
